required_choices: Keep legacy defaults and behavior unchanged.
Validate only explicitly supplied portable entries and protected paths.
Apply NFC, case/prefix collision, portable-path, entry-kind, and non-privileged mode rules.
Do not treat empty directories as source identity.
Enforce the stated entry, byte, depth, path, and component bounds.
